jyutping: jau4 sai1 naam4 fong1 lei4 ge3 N

english.note: Use this when the noun or force is coming from the southwest, especially with wind.

examples.english: The wind coming from the southwest will get stronger tonight.
examples.traditional: 由西南方嚟嘅風今晚會大啲。
